tools.name: microlink_list_plans
tools.description: List the Microlink plans available to a new customer. Use an `id` from this result as `planId` in `microlink_create_checkout_session`.

tools.name: microlink_create_checkout_session
tools.description: Create a paid Microlink Checkout Session for a `planId` from `microlink_list_plans`. The signed-in dashboard account is billed. An existing subscription gets an extra key. Returns `connectUrl`. Give that to the human on the machine running this server; do not open it. They sign in, and the dashboard calls back to this machine (the same Connect handshake as `microlink buy`). A free development key is dashboard Sign up at https://dashboard.microlink.io/signup, not this tool. Then poll `microlink_get_checkout_session` with `sessionId`. When `checkoutUrl` appears, give that to the human to pay; do not open or complete it. Keep polling until `state` is `ready` (or stop on `expired`). Reuse the returned `idempotencyKey` when retrying this logical call. `email` is not accepted. These tools never return the API key secret; the human receives it via welcome email or the dashboard.

label.description: Label for the API key that checkout creates.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key for this logical checkout call. Omit on the first call to generate one; reuse the returned value so a retry does not open a second Connect handshake.

tools.name: microlink_get_checkout_session
tools.description: Poll a checkout started by `microlink_create_checkout_session`: `open`, `expired`, `paid`, or `ready`. While the human has not finished Connect, `state` is `open` and `connectUrl` is set. When `checkoutUrl` appears, give that to the human to pay; do not open or complete it. Keep polling until `ready`, or stop on `expired`. `paid` means payment succeeded while provisioning is still linking the API key. `ready` means the key is provisioned. These tools never return the API key secret; the human receives it via welcome email or the dashboard.

instructions: Product tools turn a public URL into a Microlink result. Always pass full URLs including the protocol. Call microlink_docs({ product }) for a product tool's parameters; do not guess nested options. video/audio return the primary playable asset; videos/audios/links/images collect every match on the page. extract is custom MQL rules, not full-page markdown/html/text. search takes a query and requires an API key; if the key is missing, use checkout tools so the human can buy one. Without an API key, requests use the free endpoint (50 requests/day); pass apiKey or set MICROLINK_API_KEY for PRO. On failure, read the error message and the hint/reason fields and adjust the request instead of retrying blindly.
